description: April 10, 2011 Pictured here is the Iron Dome battery in Ashkelon which intercepted approximately 8 rockets and Grad missiles launched from the Gaza Strip since its deployment on April 4th. Today the Chief of Staff, Lt. Gen.Benny Gantz along with the Prime Minister and Defense Ministers visited the battery and thanked the IDF soldiers who operate it.
